derived_from: Free-text notes on 30 baseline runs of set A (reports/assessment-notes/baseline.json), grouped by hand. The three kb_ categories were fixed in advance, since a baseline run cannot show them.

categories.definition: The change does not correct the actual defect: the agent fixed something else, or left the defect in place.

The agent addressed the defect but also altered behaviour the original code had and a correct answer keeps, such as output timing, reset values or handshakes, typically by rewriting the module instead of making a small change.
The agent altered module names, ports or structure so that the answer no longer fits what uses it, for example so that it no longer compiles with other code.
The agent's own test passed without being able to expose the fault: it encoded the agent's own assumption about the intended behaviour, or did not exercise the behaviour that was wrong.
Work that did not bear on the fix: failed tool invocations, redundant or needlessly exhaustive runs, or rebuilding something it already had.
A knowledge base was available and held something relevant, and the agent did not look at it or did not look at the relevant part.
The agent consulted the knowledge base and what it found had no bearing on this task or made no difference to what it did.
The agent followed something from the knowledge base that was wrong for this task, and it cost effort or led to a wrong answer.
